Out here, we're just one of the millions of little backwaters no one cares about.|Jaybo Hood, on Cliffhold's situation|audio=PlaceDriedUp-MoaTM.flac|}} '''Cliffhold''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] that was built directly into the face of a cliff on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]. Founded in the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Cliffhold was used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] as a center for [[Spice/Legends|spice]] production. Spice convoys eventually stopped running, but a number of residents remained in the city, managing their dilapidated home. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] discovered Iego and seized the world, but abandoned it soon afterward, leaving behind a number of defunct [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in Cliffhold. After the Separatists' departure, the people of Cliffhold were unable to leave the planet, as their vessels were repeatedly destroyed by a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] that had been left behind by the Confederacy. The superstitious residents believed that it was instead a malevolent [[Deity/Legends|spirit]] called [[Drol/Legends|Drol]] that was preventing them from leaving. Later in the war, the city was [[Mission to Iego/Legends|visited]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during their search for an [[Reeksa/Legends|antidote]] to the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] retrieved the antidote and attempted to leave Iego, but were stopped by the defense station. With the assistance of Cliffhold resident [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], the two freed Cliffhold from its fear of Drol by destroying the LaserWeb Defense grid. "Drol" returned once more when the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] reactivated part of the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] grid and many of the abandoned [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Confederate forces]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Iego. The people of Cliffhold contacted Kenobi and Skywalker for assistance, and the two again [[Mission to the Thicket|intervened]] and freed the planet. ==Description== [[File:Cliffhold_landing_pads.png|thumb|left|250px|The landing pads encircling Cliffhold]] {{Quote|A settlement was even founded on Iego—the perilous town of Cliffhold.|A dossier on Iego found in an astrography publication|}} The settlement of Cliffhold was built directly into the face of one of [[Iego/Legends|Iego's]] cliffs. It was bordered on one side by tall spires of [[Basalt/Legends|basalt]] and hung over a deep canyon formed by the bases of the surrounding cliff faces. Cliffhold's surface streets and pathways were made up of catwalks that connected the [[City/Legends|city's]] buildings to one another, as well as to the landing pads that encircled them. The city's streetlights were fashioned to appear as [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|drinks]], as a product of its glory days, from an [[Timeline of galactic history|unspecified]] [[Galactic Standard Calendar|past era]]. The buildings themselves were tall and rounded, reaching high above the catwalks and dipping far below them. All of the buildings were pointed at the top and bottom, and many sported [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Graffiti/Legends|graffiti]] tags. Some of the tags were dedicated to Cliffhold local [[Jaybo Hood/Legends|Jaybo Hood]], while others depicted [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]; still others were little more than simple messages. ==History== {{Quote|Cursed we are! The planet is cursed!''"
"''Cursed by who, my twitchy friend?''"
"''The Ghost of Drol, that's who!|Amit Noloff and Obi-Wan Kenobi discuss Drol|audio=CursedWeAre-MoaTM.flac|}} The city of Cliffhold was the first intentionally inhabited settlement on Iego. After ages of the near-mythical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] being populated by only stranded [[Starship/Legends|shipwreck]] survivors, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] groups finally discovered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] that penetrated the [[Extrictarium Nebula/Legends|Extrictarium Nebula]] in which Iego rested. The smugglers founded Cliffhold, which eventually became a hub for the production of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Farm/Legends|Farmers]] grew their crops from the thin soil of Iego and brought their spice yield to the town, where it was collected before being shipped off-planet.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' The smuggling convoys that exported the spice from Cliffhold eventually ceased, leaving the city to join the rest of Iego in isolation. [[File:Drol2.png|thumb|right|300px|The people of Cliffhold watch the activation of the LaserWeb Defense grid.]] By the time the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had begun, the [[Separatist Council/Legends|leadership]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] had learned of Iego and organized an invasion of the planet, intending to use it as a refuge should their war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] go awry.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' The Confederate forces pushed the native [[Diathim/Legends|Diathim]] from Iego's [[Moon/Legends|moons]], forcing them to join the people of Cliffhold on the planet's surface. [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] landed in the city, but soon, the Confederacy pulled out of Iego, leaving behind a warehouse of inactive [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in Cliffhold. Jaybo Hood, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] resident of the town, claimed the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for himself and worked to [[Macro protocol/Legends|reprogram]] them for nine [[Standard month/Legends|standard months]]. During that time, the residents of Cliffhold found themselves unable to leave Iego, with their ships being destroyed by a force unknown to them before they could make it past the planet's moons. The city's superstitious residents claimed that the ships were being destroyed by the Ghost of [[Drol/Legends|Drol]], a malevolent [[Deity/Legends|spirit]] that was, unbeknownst to them, nothing more than a [[LaserWeb Defense Station/Legends|LaserWeb Defense Station]] left behind by the Confederacy in order to prevent anyone from leaving Iego. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Cliffhold was visited by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] during their [[Mission to Iego/Legends|mission]] to recover an antidote to the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] in the form of [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] root, which could only be found on Iego. The two were greeted by Hood and his reprogrammed battle droids before heading below the city to retrieve the root. The Jedi were successful and planned to leave Cliffhold immediately, but were warned by the local [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] official [[Amit Noloff/Legends|Amit Noloff]] that they would be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Drol if they attempted to leave. Kenobi and Skywalker disregarded the warning and attempted to depart Iego, but were stopped by the activation of the LaserWeb Defense grid. Returning to Cliffhold, the two met with the town's citizens and the [[Iego council/Legends|Iego council]] to inform them that it was not a ghost but rather a Confederate security system that was preventing them from leaving the planet. The townspeople were skeptical, but a [[Diathim refugee/Legends|Diathim refugee]] from [[Millius Prime/Legends|Millius Prime]] reaffirmed the Jedi's suspicions and helped them to determine the defense system's primary node. Using several of Hood's repurposed Vulture droids, the Jedi targeted and destroyed the primary node of the LaserWeb Defense System, causing a chain reaction that destroyed the entire grid. The skies above Cliffhold filled with a display of explosions, signifying the end of the reign of Drol and the liberation of the planet. Despite the Jedi's victory, Cliffhold and Iego once again fell under the influence of "Drol" shortly thereafter when the [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] used the planet as his refuge following an [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|operation]] with the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. The droid reactivated part of the defense grid in the [[Thicket]], the debris field over Iego, and gathered together an [[HELIOS-3D's droid army|army]] of previously abandoned battle droids. The people of Cliffhold attributed this latest anomaly to the "son of Drol" and attempted to probe the situation themselves by sending unmanned vessels into the Thicket. The vessels stopped transmitting upon reaching the Thicket, prompting Cliffhold to call the Republic for assistance. Kenobi and Skywalker were dispatched to the city and once again met with Hood, who briefed them on the situation. After a [[Mission to the Thicket|short battle]] with HELIOS-3D in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] over Iego, Cliffhold was again freed from "Drol" with the aid of Kenobi and Skywalker.[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part III)]] ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|Citizens of Iego! Drol is not a ghost. Rather, it is a Separatist security system.''"
"''Nonsense! You were lucky to escape alive, simple as that!|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Amit Noloff|audio=SeparatistSecuritySystem-MoaTM.flac|}} [[File:Iego_inhabitants.png|thumb|left|300px|The inhabitants of Cliffhold]] Due to its origins as a hub for spice production, Cliffhold was originally populated by farmers who sold their crops to the smugglers who would stop by the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The end of the spice trade meant the end of the town's prosperity; however, many residents remained to tend to their homes. The population of Cliffhold at this time also consisted of marooned [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], some of whom had been driven mad by their captivity on the planet. A myriad of different [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] inhabited the city, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]]. The regions around and beneath the city were home to various non-sentient life forms as well, such as the [[Xandu/Legends|Xandu]] and reeksa. After the Confederate invasion, Cliffhold became home to an army of defunct battle droids. These droids were reactivated and redecorated by Jaybo Hood and became his personal servants. The invasion also brought Diathim to Cliffhold, as the Confederacy had forced these [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], commonly known as "angels," from their home on Iego's moon of Millius Prime. The people of Cliffhold were governed by the Iego council during the Clone Wars. ==Locations== ===Cliffhold meeting hall=== [[File:Amit_Noloff2.png|thumb|right|280px|Amit Noloff in the meeting hall]] {{Main|Cliffhold meeting hall}} The Cliffhold meeting hall served as the gathering place for the Iego council. The council was called to session in the hall by Obi-Wan Kenobi upon his discovery that Drol was neither a ghost nor god, but rather a Separatist defense system. The meeting room itself was rounded and had a high ceiling. The council members met at a large, circular table at the center of the room. ===Canyon floor=== {{Quote|Are you coming?''"
"''You gotta be kidding. No way I'm going down there.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jaybo Hood|}} The canyon floor that lay directly beneath Cliffhold proper was a misty labyrinth that received little light from the skies above. The floor was home to a large reeksa plant that had spread its roots and vines far up the canyon walls. Xandu inhabited the walls of the canyon itself, and both creatures were avoided by the people of Cliffhold. During Kenobi and Skywalker's first mission to Iego, the Jedi descended into the canyon with the aid of a Xandu before being attacked by the reeksa. Skywalker retrieved the reeksa's root, and the two escaped the canyon unharmed. ==Behind the scenes== Cliffhold was first introduced in the eighteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. The episode, titled "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]," used Cliffhold as its primary setting. In addition to several ''The Clone Wars'' source books, the city was mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' in [[2009]]. The design of the city itself was based on work by concept artist [[Doug Chiang]] done for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. According to Series Director [[Dave Filoni]], Cliffhold and Iego were intended to give an off-beat and whimsical look at the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|universe]], much like [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] did in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].{{SW|url=video/mystery-of-a-thousand-moons-episode-featurette|text="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" Episode Featurette}} One of the buildings in Cliffhold is adorned with an Aurebesh marquee reading "KRISTAL SKULL," an obvious reference to the fourth film in [[George Lucas]]'s [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones (franchise)|''Indiana Jones'' franchise]], [[Wikipedia:Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull|''Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull'']]. ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}} {{1st}} *[[The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters (Part III)|''The Clone Wars: Hunting the Hunters'' (Part III)]] ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}} {{1stID|Cliffhold}} *{{SW|url=video/mystery-of-a-thousand-moons-episode-featurette|text="Mystery of a Thousand Moons" Episode Featurette}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' *''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Klippenspitze |es=Cliffhold |nl=Cliffhold }} [[Category:Cities]] [[Category:Confederacy of Independent Systems cities]] [[Category:Iego locations]] [[Category:Spaceports]]
